subject: Re: Application for Web Developer
body:
Hi Lance,

Before I pass this to the team, could you tell me your expected salary range and when you would be able to start?

Thanks,
Maria Santos
HR, Stark Digital

subject: Re: Junior Backend Developer application
body:
Hi Lance,

Just wanted to let you know personally that I got your email and CV. We are a small team so it may take me a week or so to get through everyone, but I will definitely come back to you.

Can you resend the CV as a PDF? The file you attached would not open on my side.

Jared

Norman Reyes, Engineering Manager at Oscorp
